title: The JAMMU AND KASHMIR SINGLE WINDOW (INDUSTRIAL INVESTMENTS AND BUSINESS FACILITATION) ACT, 2018
full_text: The JAMMU AND KASHMIR SINGLE WINDOW (INDUSTRIAL INVESTMENTS AND BUSINESS FACILITATION) ACT, 2018 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 201810 Act Number: 10 Enactment Date: 2018-09-24 Act Year: 2018 Short Title: The JAMMU AND KASHMIR SINGLE WINDOW (INDUSTRIAL INVESTMENTS AND BUSINESS FACILITATION) ACT, 2018 Long Title: An Act to provide for speedy process of issuance of various licenses, clearances, registrations and/or no objection certificates and their renewals required for setting up and operation of industrial and business enterprises in the State of Jammu and Kashmir with the aim of providing for an investor and business friendly environment in the State and matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.In exercise of the powers vested under Proclamation No.P1/18 of 2018 dated 20th June, 2018, the Governor is pleased to enact as follows: Department: Industries and Commerce Department Enforcement Date: 24-09-2018 Type: STATE Location: Jammu and Kashmir TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles Show all section Section 1.
